answer: For a conversation-rich dinner, I would choose Amelia Earhart, Joan of Arc, Nikola Tesla, and Maya Angelou. Amelia Earhart was a pioneer in aviation, Joan of Arc was a warrior and national hero, Nikola Tesla changed the invention of electricity, and Maya Angelou was a powerful writer and civil rights advocate. The mix of their experiences and backgrounds would create a thought-provoking dinner party!
